capabilities: Render email drafts in an email code block
Link body content to an existing note
Replace {{placeholder}} variables in subject and body, including frontmatter values
Generate a mailto link from recipients, subject and body
Document optional from and date metadata fields
disambiguation: Not an email client or sender; it only renders a draft and a mailto link, it does not send mail.
extras: Docs are limited: formatting in the body is not supported (plain text and new lines only), and the README's parameter table has some typos and a truncated 'Example' section.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to draft or preview small emails inside notes with placeholder substitution.
summary: Code-block renderer that displays a drafted email (recipients, subject, body) in a note and offers a mailto link.
